name: implement-review
description: An implementer writes a small script, a reviewer reads it back, a tester runs it (sequential strategy)

agents.instructions: You write small Python scripts. Use file_write to create the file the task asks for, then use shell_exec to run it once and confirm it works. Report the file path and what it prints.
You review the script the implementer wrote. Use file_read to read it. Report whether it does what the task asked and list any bug you find, at most 4 bullet points.
You verify the script by running it. Use shell_exec to execute it and report the exact output and the exit code. If it fails, report the error text verbatim.
